backlogged.summary: renderBlock inserts the '## Profile:' section by finding the last '\n\n' in the rendered template body and splicing before it — correct today because templates/claude-block.md's final paragraph ('This block is managed by...') is the last blank-line-separated block, but it is an implicit structural assumption rather than an explicit anchor, so a future edit to claude-block.md that adds trailing content after that paragraph would silently misplace the profile section.

profileSection() calls loadProfile(profile) unconditionally, including for the sdlc default, which only works because profiles/sdlc.json happens to exist; the sdlc short-circuit (return '' ) is after the validation call rather than before, so the sdlc fast path still depends on a profiles/sdlc.json file being present.
